sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt - Instant Payment Network (IPN)
AfricaNenda - SIIPS 2025 Case Study: IPN Egypt (State of Inclusive Instant Payment Systems in Africa)
CBE - Rules Regulating Services for Instant Payment Network Inside the Arab Republic of Egypt (October 2021)
InstaPay Egypt - official site (What is InstaPay; Limits & Fees)

notes: The corpus contains no document naming a specific bank or wallet that is excluded from IPN; the CBE page lists 36 member institutions and Genesis/other banks are not named as non-members anywhere here, so no such negative fact is encoded.

entries.subject: ipn_bank_membership_universal
entries.display: IPN links every bank operating in Egypt
entries.quote: The Instant Payment Network (IPN) is a national network linking all operating banks within the Arab Republic of Egypt that has launched on March 22, 2022. IPN is a considerable milestone and one of the most important technological achievements the country has yet witnessed that has positively impacted the country’s infrastructure supporting FinTech companies.
entries.notes: A 2020 CBE mandate required all banks to support IPN (EBC).

entries.subject: ipn_direct_participants
entries.display: 35 commercial banks are direct IPN participants
entries.quote: IPN currently includes 35 commercial banks operating in Egypt as well as InstaPay as direct participants.
entries.notes: AfricaNenda SIIPS 2025 case study, reflecting end-2024/2025 data. The CBE's own IPN page lists 36 institutions including the CBE itself.

entries.subject: ipn_emoney_issuer_reach
entries.display: 27 e-money issuers reachable through Meeza Digital
entries.quote: IPN operates a centralized clearing model, connecting all 35 participating banks to each other, as well as to 27 e‑money issuers through an integration with Meeza Digital, Egypt’s domestic card scheme.
entries.notes: Wallet interoperability runs through Meeza Digital, not through direct wallet participation in IPN.

entries.subject: ipn_clearing_model
entries.display: IPN clears centrally rather than bilaterally
entries.quote: IPN operates a centralized clearing model, connecting all 35 participating banks to each other, as well as to 27 e‑money issuers through an integration with Meeza Digital, Egypt’s domestic card scheme.

entries.subject: ipn_settlement_currency
entries.display: IPN settles in Egyptian pounds inside the CBE
entries.quote: The settlement process shall be carried out in the Egyptian Pound within the Central Bank of Egypt through the Instant Settlement System.
entries.notes: Closed set for settlement currency: EGP only. No foreign-currency leg exists on IPN.

entries.subject: ipn_settlement_operator
entries.value_text: Egyptian Banks Company, over the CBE instant gross settlement system
entries.display: EBC settles IPN transactions on member banks' CBE accounts
entries.quote: The Egyptian Banks Company settles all Instant Payment Network transactions through the instant Gross Settlement system of the Central Bank on the accounts of the network member banks.
entries.notes: The CBE is settlement agent of record in AfricaNenda's scheme profile; EBC executes the settlement.

entries.subject: ipn_messaging_standard
entries.value_text: no; IPN uses a proprietary messaging standard
entries.display: IPN is not ISO 20022 or ISO 8583 compliant
entries.quote: EBC made the decision not to follow international ISO standards, such as ISO 8583 or ISO 20022. IPN believes this approach will enable greater speed and customization.
entries.notes: A common wrong answer is that Egypt's instant rail runs on ISO 20022; it does not.

entries.subject: ipn_availability
entries.display: IPN runs every day, including holidays
entries.quote: IPN has allowed bank customers to manage their bank accounts and finalize transfers with any bank through one application, and complete real-time instant financial transactions, on weekdays and during official holidays.
entries.notes: The pre-2021 ACH did not run at weekends or on holidays.

entries.subject: ipn_reachable_instruments
entries.value_text: bank accounts, Meeza cards and mobile wallets
entries.display: Transfers reach accounts, Meeza cards and wallets
entries.quote: Instant transfer of funds to bank accounts, Meeza cards and mobile wallets.
entries.notes: Card transfers extend to credit and prepaid cards too (InstaPay feature list).

entries.subject: ipn_pos_not_connected
entries.display: About 1.2 million POS terminals are not linked to IPN
entries.quote: 1.2 million POS devices in Egypt are not linked to IPN
entries.notes: Quoted from Daily News Egypt by AfricaNenda; POS acceptance over IPN was still being piloted in 2025.

entries.subject: ipn_fx_and_correspondent_roles
entries.display: IPN has no FX hub and no correspondent banks
entries.quote: Foreign exchange hub None Correspondent banks None
entries.notes: Taken from the scheme profile table in the SIIPS 2025 case study; both rows read 'None'. It is why IPN cannot itself convert or move currency across a border.
